kal0: Can this test tell me for certain whether I will fall?
kal1: No. The UK national health guideline from NICE (2025) advises against using a test or scoring tool on its own to predict falls risk; tests like this help to spot problems with walking and balance. Studies in healthy older people living independently also show that this test alone does not predict falls. So if you have fallen in the past year, tell your doctor whatever your result. If you have fallen more than once, were injured in a fall, lost consciousness or could not get up from the floor without help, you can ask for a full falls assessment.
